legacy_payload.best_for: 以极致留白与冷灰低饱和营造高级、克制、画廊质感的场景
legacy_payload.visual_direction: quiet gallery minimalism, stark whites, cool alabasters, slate gray, charcoal, thin lines, generous margins, grid-based layout, bold sans-serif headers with light body, high-end understated restraint

canvas.background: stark white / cool alabaster, very wide margins
canvas.composition: semantic grid, one calibrated focal object, gallery-negative-space

color_palette.accent: a single warm or steel accent (steel blue #64748B), sparingly
color_palette.rule: gallery restraint, low saturation, cool tones; avoid warm gold-heavy, avoid neon

typography.title: bold modern sans-serif header (Helvetica / 思源黑体), sharp and confident

legacy_payload.layout_usage_rule: Treat every slide like a gallery wall: one focal piece, calibrated negative space, cold precise grid.

visual_elements.allowed: thin lines, gallery negative space, scale contrast, one accent, precise alignment
visual_elements.avoid: decoration, stocky texture, multiple colors, busy infographic, warm heavy gold

rendering_constraints: Calm, precise, gallery-grade restraint is the point.
One focal element per slide; whitespace must feel intentional.
No logos or watermarks unless part of the brand.
